      "rationale": "Fixes data races in RPC commands when reading block header and chain stats concurrently with block receipt. Per the description, getblockheader, getchaintxstats, and dumptxoutset previously read nTx and m_chain_tx_count without holding cs_main."

      "name": "validation",

      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Enforces locking invariants on CBlockIndex to eliminate potential data races during background block receipt and AssumeUTXO syncing. The description notes that m_chain_tx_count can race if a pruned node redownloads a block via getblockfrompeer or during AssumeUTXO background chain sync."
